create_dirs.description: Create directories to store sniffed sessions

dirs_per_batch.description: Number of sessions per directory before creating a new one

display_mode.description: Display mode for payload: P (printable), R (raw), U (unprintable as hex), H (hex-spaced)

interface.description: Network interface to listen on (e.g., eth0, ppp0)

max_closed_connections.description: Exit after this many connections are CLOSED. 0 means unlimited.

max_connections.description: Max connections to track. 0 means unlimited.

max_packets.description: Max packets to sniff before exiting. 0 means unlimited.

no_promiscuous.description: Don't put interface in promiscuous mode

pipe_mode.description: Pipe mode: 'client', 'server', or '' for normal operation

resolve_hosts.description: Display host names instead of IP addresses

timestamp_format.description: Timestamp format: 't' for h:m:s:us, 'td' for day-month-year, '' for none

use_separator.description: Add a separator for displayed payloads

write_mode.description: Write mode for stream reconstruction: R (raw), P (printable), U (unprintable as hex), H (hex-spaced)
